# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.

completion:
Determine the time period of interest.
3. Find the emission rate of a particular contaminant for the time-period of interest.

- Add up the hourly emissions for all the hours of the period of interest.
- Divide the daily emission rate by the number of hours of the day to get the average emission rate for the day and period of interest _or_
- Find a conservative estimate of the emission rate for the period of interest.

4. Use your knowledge of the contaminant and the impact it may have on the health of the particular area to determine if the emission rate is excessive.
5. Present your findings in a written, easily understandable format.
6. Review and edit your work.
